verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents fully API-driven operation, with programmatic agent self-signup that needs no Console. It also documents a CLI shipped as a single native binary with no runtime dependencies. These are strong building blocks for headless automation, but no evidence explicitly covers CI usage. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions or pipeline examples), non-interactive CLI auth via environment variables, independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Create, manage, and operate email inboxes entirely via API.
It ships as a single native binary with no runtime dependencies.
For agents that sign themselves up programmatically, no Console or dashboard needed.
